description_en: Retrieves the log of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-instance-log --instance-id 000000-d700e680-aa4d-4ec1-afc2-6566b5ff4d7a-85d44d4bfc-00000 --container-id sidecar-test-01 --previous false --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sidecar container. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834847.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
Sidecar容器ID。需要调用
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834847.html接口获取

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to view the log of the instance from before its last restart. Note: This parameter is active only if the instance was restarted
parameters.help_zh: 查看实例上次重启前的日志。注意：仅在实例出现重启时可用
parameters.name: previous
